units: <cite ref="Gittin 88b:5">Gitt. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>בני עַשּׂוּיֵי</he> lawfully qualified to force (a divorce).
<cite ref="Ketubot 50a:1">Keth. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>עַשִּׂיתִינְהוּ לזניה</he> (read: <he>לזוניה</he>) I caused them (persuaded them, v. Tosaf. a. l.) to support him.

<cite ref="Ketubot 50a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אי אמרת … משום הכי עַשְּׂיִינְהוּ וכ׳</he> if the law is that they are not bound to support him, then he had to persuade them; but if the law requires them to do it, what necessity was there to persuade them? Ib. 53ᵃ <he>לעַשּׂוּיֵיה נמי</he> is it also permitted to influence him? Ib. <he>מי … עול ועַשְּׂיֵיה עול ולא תְעַשְּׂיֵיה וכ׳</he> did I say to thee, go in and influence him? I said, go, but do not influence him. Ib. <he>היינו עשייה</he> (read: <he>עַשּׂוּיֵיה</he>), v. <cite ref="P01468"><he>עִשּׂוּי</he></cite>; a. e.
